package.description: LMMS is a free cross-platform alternative to commercial programs like FL Studio®, which allow you to produce music with your computer.

en-US.description: LMMS is a free cross-platform alternative to commercial programs like FL Studio®, which allow you to produce music with your computer.
en-US.longDescription: LMMS is a free cross-platform alternative to commercial programs like FL Studio®, which allow you to produce music with your computer. This includes the creation of melodies and beats, the synthesis and mixing of sounds, and arranging of samples. You can have fun with your MIDI-keyboard and much more; all in a user-friendly and modern interface.
en-US.name: LMMS

zh-CN.description: LMMS 是一款免费、跨平台的音乐制作软件，可作为 FL Studio® 等商业软件的替代选择，让您通过电脑创作音乐。
zh-CN.longDescription: LMMS 是一款免费、跨平台的音乐制作软件，可作为 FL Studio® 等商业软件的替代选择。它让您能够通过电脑创作音乐，包括编写旋律与节奏、合成与混音以及采样编排。您还可以连接 MIDI 键盘进行演奏，体验更多功能——所有这些都集成在一个现代化且用户友好的界面中。
